briefing: Markets jumped sharply today, with the NASDAQ up 6.6% and the S&P 500 up 4.9%. That is a strong risk-on day, so we are putting our remaining $646 of idle cash to work as our strategy notes recommend. We are buying NVIDIA, the only candidate where all four momentum signals line up, and holding all 7 existing positions so the automatic profit targets and stop-losses can do their job.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money out of safe assets and into riskier ones like growth and tech stocks, which pushes the major indexes sharply higher. Momentum strategies tend to work best on these days, so it is a good time to put idle cash to work. Volume confirmation still matters, because heavy trading volume suggests big institutions are buying and the move is less likely to be a one-day blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「風險偏好」（Risk-On）市況，是指投資者信心回升，資金從避險資產流向成長股、科技股等較高風險的資產，帶動主要指數大幅上揚。動能策略在這類日子往往最為奏效，正是把閒置現金投入市場的好時機。不過成交量的確認依然重要：成交放量代表大型機構資金積極入市，升勢較不易只是曇花一現。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rallied broadly today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ gaining 6.6% and the S&P 500 rising 4.9%. Semiconductor and AI hardware names led the move, and the screened list is full of chip and data-center names (NVDA, MU, INTC, DELL, HPE) showing fresh bullish MACD crossovers. No news headlines came with today's data, so we can't cite a specific trigger; a one-day move this large usually follows a major macro surprise or policy news and should be confirmed in the next few sessions.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面強彈，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數急升6.6%，標普500指數亦漲4.9%。半導體與AI硬體板塊領漲，候選名單中NVDA、MU、INTC、DELL、HPE等晶片及數據中心概念股紛紛出現MACD黃金交叉。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，暫無法引述具體催化因素；單日如此大的升幅，通常源於重大宏觀數據意外或政策消息，後市仍需數個交易日確認升勢能否延續。

trades.reasoning: NVDA is the only candidate with all four confirmation signals today: RSI 63.4 in the bullish zone, MACD above its signal line, price well above SMA-20, and a volume surge above 1.5x the 20-day average, which points to institutional buying.
